title: Fractal Audio FM9

x_pc.additionalInfo: Use MIDI Bank Select CC0 values 0-3 plus PC 0-127 to select FM9 presets 0-511.

additionalInfo: Incoming MIDI CCs are globally assignable in SETUP > MIDI/Remote to functions including input and output volumes, tap tempo, tuner, 16 external controllers, scene functions, all looper functions, and all block bypass/channel switches. Scene values select scenes 1-8, repeating every 8 values; channel values select A-D, repeating every 4 values. FM9 can transmit PC messages on preset change or via Scene MIDI Block / Control Switch MIDI, can transmit CC via Scene MIDI Block or Control Switch MIDI, receives MIDI clock, and does not transmit MIDI clock.
